'''November 2000 Milwaukee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hegan's Field Of Dreams, Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 18 November 2000. It is known from Bryan Prittie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1466">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-hegans-field-of-dreams-milwaukee-wid1466/ hegans-field-of-dreams-milwaukee-wi], DeckTech (Bryan "DMX" Prittie, 18 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-hegans-field-of-dreams-milwaukee-wid1466/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Hegan's Field Of Dreams, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
